notes:
First build that updates itself.

- The app checks for a new build, downloads it in the background, and installs
  it when you quit. Nothing is replaced while you are working.
- A real plan set opens in under a second. An 84.6 MB, 62-sheet issued-for-
  construction set used to take eight seconds to show its first sheet.
- The estimate page opens instantly on a big job — 4,000 marks went from 29
  seconds to under one.
- Click any figure in the Cost column to see the marks on the sheet behind it.
- 1-9 and the bracket keys switch which group you are measuring into, without
  leaving the drawing.
- Cost codes carry through to invoices and purchase orders.
- Photos taken on an iPhone no longer show as broken images.
